title: SR-1.02 No AI-drafted command runs without local approval
request: Closes G02: Contract verify runs sh -c commands a local session drafted and signed in one turn (contracts.mjs:213-228). Repository: mgillr/memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Approval gate for local command criteria
requirements: a command or metric criterion runs only after a human ran memev contract approve <id> on this machine, whatever the origin
approval records the hash of the command set; any amend needs a fresh approval
workdir must be inside a path the operator approved, never taken from the contract alone

criteria.statement: An unapproved local contract reports BLOCKED and spawns nothing
The threat model covers locally drafted commands

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
